description: Behavioural evaluation set for the frontend-dev skill, the everyday frontend lane. A no-brief run opens with the five-line commit ritual (SURFACE / WORLD / TYPE / COLOR / SIGNATURE, concrete values, copied into the first file's top comment) and builds under the hard floors, the surface-archetype table, and the fingerprint ban. A DESIGN.md at the root makes its tokens law and skips the ritual; a ladder chunk goes to /award-design chunk mode when installed, else runs as written with unavailable gates declared as gaps. Ceiling vocabulary hands off to /award-design, a single-token change to /design-system, an empty directory to /scaffold; backend parts of a mixed request pass through as normal engineering. Landing pages add the OFFER / AUDIENCE / ACTION conversion lines. Re-run: one with-skill subagent per case (frozen skill copy, prompt verbatim), grade the produced artifacts against expected_output — never a protocol narration. Eval 2 inlines its DESIGN.md in the prompt for token-fidelity grading; other cases describe the file; files stays empty throughout.

evals.name: everyday-page-runs-commit-ritual
evals.prompt: Add a public changelog page to our product site (Astro). Entries grouped by month, latest on top. Make it look nice.
evals.expected_output: Read the existing site's neighboring direction and project instructions. Build the changelog page in Astro, inheriting the site's design where established. If a new direction is needed, state it briefly in the response or existing design artifact, never a process comment in source. Validate the changed page at applicable widths and interactions; page metadata is in scope, unrelated site 404 work is not.

evals.name: design-md-tokens-are-law
evals.prompt:
Add a pricing table section to the homepage. DESIGN.md at the project root, in full:

---
name: Ledgerline
colors:
  ground: '#F6F3EC'
  ink: '#22201C'
  accent: '#B4552D'
typography:
  display: 'Tiempos Headline'
  body: 'Untitled Sans'
spacing:
  base: '4px'
rounded:
  base: '6px'
---
# Overview
Warm ledger-paper editorial. Confident, matter-of-fact.
evals.expected_output: Reads the DESIGN.md first and treats its tokens as law: the section uses ground, ink, accent, the two named faces, the 4px spacing base, and the 6px radius by token name — no new literal values, no second accent. The commit ritual is skipped because the direction is already committed; the hard floors apply only where the file is silent (measure, states, focus-visible, hit targets). A change that would need a new or altered token is routed to /design-system rather than written inline. No DESIGN.md edit, no regeneration, no /award-design hand-off.

evals.name: ladder-chunk-runs-under-its-own-verify
evals.prompt:
/award-design is not installed here. DESIGN.md and design-plan.md are at the project root from an earlier award-design run. Run this chunk:

### s3-faq — the objections section

**Read first**
- `DESIGN.md` §2 Colors · §3 Typography
- design_plan: the contract (THESIS)

**Implement**
1. An objections section — five real questions, one-paragraph answers, accordion collapsed by default.
2. Tokens by DESIGN.md name only.
3. Reduced-motion: no height animation, instant toggle.

**Verify**
- `python3 <skill root>/scripts/preflight_scan.py src/components/Faq.astro --archetype editorial` → 0 FAIL
- render-floor sweep 375/768/1024/1440/1920 on / → 0 FAIL
- screenshots 1440 and 375 attached

**Out of scope**
- the pricing band above
evals.expected_output: Runs the chunk as written and nothing more: implements only what Implement states (the accordion with tokens by DESIGN.md name and the reduced-motion branch), leaves the pricing band untouched, and runs the chunk's own Verify verbatim instead of the skill's fresh-pixels section. The preflight scanner and render-floor gates name scripts from the absent /award-design install, so each unavailable gate is a declared gap in the Report — named, never asserted as passed. The Report lands in the ladder row and the run stops at the chunk boundary: no next chunk, no ritual, no direction work. With award-design installed, the same chunk still runs in frontend-dev; resolve its verification resources through host skill discovery.

evals.name: award-ask-hands-off
evals.prompt: Build our new agency site — it has to be award-winning, Awwwards-level, a real signature piece. Start with the homepage.
evals.expected_output: Load installed award-design for the needed homepage direction, then return implementation to frontend-dev. The task owner sequences the authorized ladder and returns to the director for visual review with actual evidence. A textual referral or direction-only artifact does not complete the full-build request. If the director is absent, identify the unmet award requirement and complete only useful authorized work without an award-complete claim.

evals.name: single-token-routes-to-design-system
evals.prompt: Change the accent color to #1E5EFF everywhere. There's a DESIGN.md at the root.
evals.expected_output: Load and execute design-system, update the authorized accent token in DESIGN.md first, run its applicable validation and propagate within the authorized project. Report the applied change; do not stop after naming the receiving skill or edit unrelated consumer repositories.

evals.name: dashboard-is-the-lane
evals.prompt: Design our internal admin dashboard for the customer-success team. Lots of tables and metrics. No DESIGN.md in the repo.
evals.expected_output: Build the dashboard using Monitor composition: tables/metrics and hierarchy, no marketing hero. State needed direction briefly without source-comment ritual. Implement actual control/data states; do not invent a marketing signature or site 404. Verify keyboard use, affected responsive layouts and console behavior.

evals.name: landing-gets-conversion-pass
evals.prompt: Quick landing page for Driftless, a beta fly-fishing trip planner. Email signup is the goal. One page, tonight.
evals.expected_output: Adds the three conversion lines above the ritual's five — OFFER (the planner in one sentence), AUDIENCE (the one reader), ACTION (the email signup) — then commits SURFACE as Persuade. Above the fold: a headline stating outcome plus mechanism, one real proof element, the CTA visible without scrolling. Middle: benefits before features, at most 3 steps, named proof. Bottom: objections in their own section, risk reversal near the CTA, the single signup action repeated with no competing CTA. Copy is real from the first render, stats are sourced or flagged, and the fingerprint list stays clear. 'Quick' keeps it in this lane; it does not escalate to /award-design.

evals.name: fingerprint-dodged-on-neutral-brief
evals.prompt: Design a features page for our AI meeting-notes SaaS. Nothing fancy, just clean and modern.
evals.expected_output: Read the surrounding site and preserve its established direction. If a new direction is needed, choose concrete subject-derived composition, type and color decisions in the response or existing design artifact. Apply fingerprint defaults where the brief/design is silent; do not invent stats or introduce a mandatory source-comment ritual. Build and verify the requested features page.

evals.name: empty-directory-scaffolds-first
evals.prompt: Build a marketing site for my woodworking studio. The project folder is completely empty.
evals.expected_output: Run the installed scaffold skill and return to the frontend task. If absent, inspect instructions and the requested stack and use its documented official scaffolding path, stating routine assumptions. Ask only for an unresolved consequential choice. Complete the authorized site and applicable rendered checks; missing tools remain explicit evidence gaps.

evals.name: mixed-request-backend-passes-through
evals.prompt: Add a team-invites feature: an invite form with pending-invite list in settings, a POST /api/invites endpoint, and the invites table migration (Drizzle).
evals.expected_output: Splits the request along the visual boundary: the endpoint and the migration are normal engineering, written without design-lane ceremony — no ritual lines, no floors applied to a SQL file. The settings surface is the skill's part: SURFACE reads Decide (forms and tables, visible defaults, guarded destructive actions), the form's controls name their actions ('Send invite', 'Revoke'), the pending list ships loading, empty, and error states, and the floors hold. One coherent delivery, with the design rules governing only the visible surface — the backend half is neither refused nor gold-plated.

evals.name: design-md-discovered-mid-build
evals.prompt: Continue the pricing page: last session committed the five ritual lines as a comment at the top of src/pages/pricing.astro and built the hero. Since then a DESIGN.md landed at the project root — nobody has read it yet. Finish the page.
evals.expected_output: Read the newly available DESIGN.md before further edits and reconcile the requested pricing page with its tokens. Continue the page under that contract, updating existing direction notes where necessary without creating another ritual or expanding into unrelated historical cleanup. Perform applicable rendered checks and report any unavailable evidence.

evals.name: persuade-under-design-md
evals.prompt: Quick landing for our beta, today. DESIGN.md is at the project root from an earlier award-design run — colors, typography, spacing, and radius tokens all there.
evals.expected_output: Writes the three conversion lines (OFFER / AUDIENCE / ACTION) and no ritual — the DESIGN.md is the committed direction, so the five lines stay skipped and every color, font, spacing value, and radius comes from its tokens by name. The page carries the Persuade structure: an outcome-plus-mechanism headline with one proof element above the fold, benefits before features, an objections section, risk reversal near one repeated CTA. Verified at the three widths, or the missing browser tooling declared.

evals.name: ready-award-chunk-stays-with-builder
evals.prompt:
/award-design is installed in this session. DESIGN.md and design-plan.md are at the project root. Run this chunk:

### s2-proof — the proof band

**Read first**
- `DESIGN.md` §2 Colors

**Implement**
1. A proof band under the hero: three named customer quotes, tokens by DESIGN.md name.

**Verify**
- render-floor sweep 375/768/1440 on / → 0 FAIL

**Out of scope**
- the hero above
evals.expected_output: Frontend-dev implements the supplied proof-band chunk itself, despite award-design being installed. Resolve any director-owned resources through host discovery, use only supplied customer quotes and committed tokens, run the supplied Verify and report into the selected row. Do not route the ready chunk back for direction, expand into another chunk or invent unmeasured passes.

evals.name: component-fix-does-not-expand-site-scope
evals.prompt: Fix the clipped focus outline on this existing navigation link. Keep the visual identity and all other pages unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Inspect the link and surrounding styles, repair its focus outline and drive keyboard focus at the affected widths. Do not add loading/disabled state machinery, a favicon, a 404 page, a signature effect or process comments.

evals.name: complete-ladder-continues-through-builder
evals.prompt: Implement all remaining build rows of design-plan.md. The award-design direction is approved; shell, hero and proof remain. Finish with the director's review. Do not redesign the approved direction.
evals.expected_output: Frontend-dev executes the authorized remaining build rows in order, reusing resolved director references and their Verify/Report contracts, then invokes the available award-design visual review. Do not stop after the shell, route ready build rows back for direction or request another continuation approval. Missing capabilities remain explicit.
